spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  CASE technical_name
    WHEN 'cold-flow-crew-mess' THEN 'Crew mess'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-galley' THEN 'Galley'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-dayhead' THEN 'Dayhead'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-lazaret' THEN 'Lazaret'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-laundry' THEN 'Laundry'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-deckhouse' THEN 'Deckhouse'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-owners-deckhouse' THEN 'Owners deckhouse'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-lower-saloon' THEN 'Lower saloon'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-deck-douche' THEN 'Deck douche'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-technical-space-sink' THEN 'Tech space sink'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-from-tank' THEN 'From tank'
    WHEN 'cold-flow-water-softner' THEN 'Water softner'
  END AS sensor,
  avg(flow__value) AS value
FROM public.marpower__fresh_water__flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND technical_name IN ('cold-flow-crew-mess', 'cold-flow-galley', 'cold-flow-dayhead', 'cold-flow-lazaret', 'cold-flow-laundry', 'cold-flow-deckhouse', 'cold-flow-owners-deckhouse', 'cold-flow-lower-saloon', 'cold-flow-deck-douche', 'cold-flow-technical-space-sink', 'cold-flow-from-tank', 'cold-flow-water-softner')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN g0.t1
    WHEN 2 THEN g0.t2
    WHEN 3 THEN g0.t3
    WHEN 4 THEN g0.t4
    WHEN 5 THEN g0.t5
    WHEN 6 THEN g0.t6
    WHEN 7 THEN g0.t7
    WHEN 8 THEN g0.t8
    WHEN 9 THEN g0.t9
    WHEN 10 THEN g0.t10
    WHEN 11 THEN g0.t11
    WHEN 12 THEN g0.t12
  END) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Guest cabin SB', 'coldwater_guest_cabin_sb_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Guest cabin PS FWD', 'coldwater_guest_cabin_ps_fwd_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (3, 'Guest cabin PS AFT', 'coldwater_guest_cabin_ps_aft_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (4, 'Guest bathroom PS FWD', 'coldwater_guest_bathr_ps_fwd_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (5, 'Master cabin SB', 'coldwater_master_cabin_sb_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (6, 'Master cabin PS', 'coldwater_master_cabin_ps_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (7, 'Captain''s cabin', 'coldwater_captains_cabin_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (8, 'Crew cabin SB AFT', 'coldwater_crew_cabin_sb_aft_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (9, 'Crew cabin SB MID', 'coldwater_crew_cabin_sb_mid_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (10, 'Crew cabin PS MID', 'coldwater_crew_cabin_ps_mid_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (11, 'Crew cabin SB FWD', 'coldwater_crew_cabin_sb_fwd_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (12, 'Crew cabin PS FWD', 'coldwater_crew_cabin_ps_fwd_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN g0 ON true
ORDER BY s.n
